headline: Barely knee-high but a good angle — glassy morning log at best.
today: Just 1.2-1.3ft at 4s, though it's coming from a favorable angle for Lido. Cross wind most of the day, going S onshore in the evening, so ride the morning if you ride anything. Longboard and low expectations.

daysToWatch.note: Small and short-period but solid NNW offshore all day. Clean texture if the swell cooperates — a fun log session for the patient.
Offshore N/NW morning going near-glassy midday. Still under a foot and a half, but the cleanest window of the week for a mellow log.
Warning: wind cranks S onshore to 24mph by evening. Get it early or write it off — afternoon will be blown junk.
Best of the stretch: 2.3-3ft from a good angle with offshore NNW building through the afternoon and evening. This is the day to target. Shortboard or fish.
